claim: Mount Carillon does not appear in data/peaks.csv or data/collections/sps.csv. It is believed to be a real Sierra Peaks Section peak (Whitney region, near Mount Russell/Tulainyo Lake) but this project has not independently confirmed its SPS status, elevation, or GNIS coordinates. If added, its approach relative to Whitney Portal (and whether it shares Mount Russell's permit or needs its own) is also unconfirmed against any source -- treat this as a proposal to add the peak and determine its approach, not a confirmed fact.
resolution_notes: REJECTED 2026-09-13: the claim is false. Mount Carillon is present in data/peaks.csv, stored under the Sierra Peaks Section list's misspelling 'Mount Carillion'. scripts/merge_gnis.py has mapped that to the GNIS official spelling since the coordinates were merged, so the project always knew. The report was filed because `plan.py` answered 'not found' to the correct spelling, which was a lookup bug rather than a missing peak. Fixed: peaks.csv gains an `aliases` column carrying the GNIS name, and name resolution now matches on alias and on the list's formatting markers. Nothing was added to the dataset. Kept rather than deleted -- a ledger that quietly removes its own wrong entries is worth less than one that shows them.

target_key: Wee-Ta-Chi Group Camp; Maud Whalen Group Camp; Homestead Valley Group Camp
claim: Briones' three group camping areas are drive-in: you reach the site by vehicle rather than walking in from a staging area.
evidence: None supplied. The park page, the map brochure and both ReserveAmerica pages were read in full and none of them says how these camps are reached. The claim came directly from the maintainer, whose basis for it was not stated.
resolution_notes: ACCEPTED 2026-09-16 and written into access_mode, because it is consistent with every other EBRPD group camp in this dataset and the maintainer is the person reading these sources. RECORDED ANYWAY because it is the only access_mode here resting on no document, and this project's rule is that a claim carries its evidence -- a value that looks identical to the sourced ones beside it should not quietly be weaker than them. Confidence is set to secondhand as the conservative reading: if the maintainer has been to these camps it is firsthand and should be upgraded, which was not asked before storing the value. Closing this needs one line on an EBRPD page, or the information letter EBRPD emails 5-7 days before a group reservation, which carries the gate code and parking passes and would say how you arrive.
